messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the Console observability push next quarter. customers are asking for: per-route cost breakdown, live trace hooks for 95th latency flows, and an errors dashboard that correlates with model versions.

maya: TL;DR proposal: 3-lane approach -> Core dashboards (top-level cost + errors), Tracing hooks MVP (sampling + link to traces), Cost attribution beta (per-route + token-level sampling). Need dev + cs priorities.

aj: Agree on 3 lanes. Two tradeoffs: (1) sampling density vs. infra cost, (2) UI complexity vs. time-to-launch. For tracing MVP we should do attribute headers so traces can be filtered by model/version without heavy instrumentation.

leo: For sampling, default -> 1% global + adaptive bump for error spikes. Ops impact estimation: 1% should be ~20% extra trace retention for us on avg. I can run a projection if we lock expected qps.

sophia: For cost attribution, can we avoid per-token logs? We can do aggregated token buckets per route and per-model variant, stored as counters. That gives near-real-time breakdown without storing every token.

caroline: From CS: top customers (3 enterprise trials) will only accept launch if they can slice by customer id + model version and get a per-route cost delta. They want exportable CSVs. This is a gating ask for pilot.

nina: UX question: do we want a single unified dashboard with tabs or three focused dashboards? Focused is faster to build, unified is nicer for handoffs.

maya: Proposal: ship focused dashboards first (cost, errors, traces hook) with a nav that lets us merge later. Acceptance criteria (draft):
```
1) Cost dashboard: shows per-route, per-model-variant 24h delta, CSV export, <=5s query response for 30d range
2) Errors dashboard: top 10 error slices by route/model, sample stack/traces for each error, alert rule template
3) Tracing hooks MVP: header-driven sampling, UI link-out to trace viewer, 1% default sampling with adaptive bump
Canary: deploy to 2 small accounts + internal traffic for 48h, must show <2% failure in dashboard queries
```

maya: Can we surface estimated dev effort per lane? need that for roadmap card.

aj: Rough: Core dashboards ~4dev-weeks (2 FE, 1 BE, 1 infra), Tracing hooks MVP ~3dev-weeks (1 infra, 1 BE, 1 FE), Cost attribution beta ~3-5 dev-weeks depending on aggregation approach.

leo: Infra tasks: retention policy changes, index for per-route counters, tracing sampler config. Risk: if sampling is misconfigured we could overload storage. I'll own rollout plan + circuit breaker.

sophia: Data tasks: aggregation pipelines for token buckets, backfill support for customers in pilot, and expose an API for exports. Estimated 2 eng-weeks + 1 QA week.

caroline: Timeline ask from customer: pilot in 8 weeks. They understand alpha UX but need CSV exports and model-version slicing.

maya: Negotiation point: if we cut scope to meet 8-week pilot, recommended minimum to ship: Cost dashboard (aggregated buckets + CSV), Traces hooks (header sampling + link-outs), Errors dashboard (top slices + export). Cut: no token-level raw logs, no cross-customer merging.

aj: Sounds reasonable. We should add instrumentation guardrails: feature flags + per-account rollout.

leo: I'll add a canary flow: step 1 internal + staging for 72h, step 2 opt-in for pilot accounts (2 customers), step 3 10% rollout. Circuit breaker if query latencies spike >30% or storage IO > 25% above baseline.

nina: UX needs: simple CSV schema, two widgets (time series + top-slice table), and a link for "view traces" that opens the trace viewer with filters. I can prototype this week.

maya: Decision call? If everyone agrees we'll put this in the roadmap with target M-2 delivery for QA. Comments? :eyes:

aj: +1, but add a hard stop: no per-token retention in v1.

leo: +1 to rollout plan. I'll prepare infra runbook and threshold checks.

sophia: +1 on aggregation approach; will draft pipeline spec and sample queries.

caroline: +1 from CS — will prep pilot customers and checklist.

maya: Great — I'll update the roadmap doc: https://redwood-internal/obs/roadmap and create PR for the acceptance criteria. I'll ping infra/qa for scheduling. Thanks all :thumbsup:
